Lemma
[$C^\infty $ smoothness of the parallel frame and the Jacobi coefficient]

↗ lem:dc-ch5-2-1-parallel-frame ↗ lem:dc-ch5-2-1-real-curvature

1. ch5:2.7Along a smooth geodesic in a coordinate chart, the parallel orthonormal frame of section 1 may be chosen smooth. Consequently, \[ A(t)=\big(\langle R(\gamma ',e_i)\gamma ',e_j\rangle \big)_{ij} \] is smooth in $t$.
Proof

\sketch In coordinates the parallel-transport equation is the linear ODE $\dot e_i=-\Gamma (\dot u,e_i)(u)$. Its coefficients are smooth, so its solutions are smooth. The assertion for $A$ follows from section 1.

□
